description: This Swift source file defines a utility enum 'OpenClawKitResources' for locating and retrieving the resource bundle associated with the OpenClawKit module. It includes methods to locate the bundle in various environments such as packaged applications, SwiftPM development/testing setups, with fallback mechanisms. The code manages resource bundle paths in different contexts to prevent crashes if resources are missing or paths differ.

classes.name: BundleLocator
classes.description: A helper class used solely for obtaining a reference to a bundle via 'Bundle(for:)', facilitating bundle lookup logic.

methods.name: locateBundle()
methods.description: Determines and returns the appropriate resource bundle for OpenClawKit by checking multiple locations depending on the app environment.

methods.name: loadModuleBundleSafely()
methods.description: Attempts to locate the module's resource bundle in various probable directories to avoid runtime crashes caused by missing Bundle.module in SwiftPM environments.
